claim: GitHub Copilot's per-seat subscription pricing created a structural loss: the Wall Street Journal reported in October 2023 that Copilot averaged a $20/user/month loss against a $10/user/month subscription price because heavy users' inference cost exceeded the seat fee by 2-3x.
stance_target: subscription vs API/usage-based economics for AI agent products (Pillar 6)
quoted_support: The Wall Street Journal reported in October 2023 that the Copilot business averaged a $20-per-user monthly loss against a $10-per-user-per-month subscription price. Heavy users were consuming inference compute that exceeded the seat fee by 2-3x.

claim: Per-outcome pricing (charging only for a defined business result) transfers cost-variance risk from buyer to seller and is viable only when the seller can predict average cost-per-outcome within a tight band and the outcome is auditable.
stance_target: cost/resource optimization model selection for AI software factory outputs (Pillar 6)
quoted_support: Per Outcome transfers cost variance from the buyer to the seller. If the AI consumes more compute than the outcome's price covers for a specific customer, the seller absorbs the gap.

claim: Most mature production AI businesses run hybrid pricing models combining a subscription base with consumption overage or prepaid credits, balancing buyer predictability with seller margin protection.
stance_target: cost architecture pattern for agentic software factory billing (Pillar 6)
quoted_support: Most production AI businesses run Hybrid models. A subscription base plus consumption overage or prepaid credits balances predictability for the buyer with margin protection for the seller.

claim: Salesforce Agentforce launched at $2 per AI-handled conversation, a per-activity price designed to roughly track Salesforce's marginal cost per conversation.
stance_target: per-activity pricing benchmarks for agentic AI products
quoted_support: Salesforce Agentforce launched at $2 per AI-handled conversation, with the per-conversation unit aligning roughly with the variable cost Salesforce incurs to handle each one.
